title: Aspect guideline (aspect.yaml)
description: One aspect of the aspect guidelines: `_ai/aspect_guidelines/<aspect>/aspect.yaml`, beside one `<choice>.md` per choice (the file name without `.md` is the choice's short name, its content the text sent). A prompt gets each aspect's effective choice: the lowest level choosing one wins (aspect default < quest default < window < run < role type < role < item < todo); `remove` on a level sends nothing for the aspect. Before format version 10 the file was `section.yaml` with `options:` (aspect-guideline-section.schema.json); the `_ai` format migration renames both.

label.description: A short label for the selection's hover help, e.g. `Answer`. Default: the name.

placement.description: Where the chosen choice's text goes: one segment of the system prompt (`system`, the default), or before the prompt text (`user`). Copilot has no system prompt: there both go before the prompt text.

default.description: The choice taken when no level chooses one (one of the aspect's choice names). Absent: nothing is sent for the aspect unless a level chooses.

when.description: A template expression (as in ${{ … }}) over the chat variables, the placeholders and the prompt facts prompt.transport, prompt.kind, prompt.todo, prompt.role, prompt.roleType, prompt.run, prompt.process, prompt.quest, prompt.workspace, prompt.night: the choice is sent only while it holds, whichever level chose it; nothing steps in for it otherwise.

choices.description: The choices' order, by short name, or as {name, when} with the choice's condition; each needs its `<name>.md` (own text or guideline file). Choice files not listed follow by name. `remove` is no choice name: it is the levels' Remove; a name does not start with `+` (it marks an added choice).

order.description: Its place among the aspects in the prompt, lowest first. Absent: after the aspects that have one, each group by id.

remove_when.description: While this expression holds the aspect sends nothing, whatever a level chose (e.g. prompt.transport == "direct").
